text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Junior Class drawing to a close, 
the time has come to decide Cheval Grand's 
goals for the Classic Class.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is a 
once-in-a-lifetime stage. Given her 
natural talent was never in question, I 
wanted to let her take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Cheval Grand felt slightly 
overwhelmed by the intensity of the other 
Umamusume. She couldn't quite take the 
leap into the Classic Triple Crown path, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she continues along the Medium and 
Long-distance routes, the day will surely 
come when she must confront those 
formidable rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After much agonizing... I decided to make 
sure she achieves her current goal, using 
that to build her confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Classic Year, we aim to place in 
the top 3 in at least three graded stakes 
races. By understanding her true strength, 
she can build her confidence.
